notes: Fresh user data per launch: the built-in Welcome plugin starts its plugin host after the window is interactive.

In-app (ADR 0014): terminal_frame_ms are frame intervals while a terminal prints a 1M-line file (cat, or type on Windows); terminal_cat_ms is until the program exited and its output was parsed; terminal_memory_mb is the managed memory the terminal keeps (10k lines of scrollback); terminal_echo_ms is a keystroke written to the default shell until its echo is rendered.
